name: @penguinharness/default-rsi-toolkit
description: The Default RSI Toolkit: the trial → reflect → improve loop as one Skill — improve an agent from its measured Benchmark results, round after round, with a snapshot before every round. It measures through the agent-evaluation Skill of the Agent Evaluation plugin.

penguin.short_description: Default RSI Toolkit: trial, reflect, improve.

quick_start.prompt: List this Project's Benchmarks with their latest scores, then propose which agent to optimize on which Benchmark and for how many rounds. Wait for my go-ahead before starting.

penguin.title: Default RSI Toolkit
